findings.title: Instructor feedback rendered unescaped with th:utext
findings.sink: th:utext rendering of rich-text fields (no shared HTML sanitizer)
findings.description: Instructor comments on assignments are rendered with th:utext. A teaching assistant account, or anyone who can edit feedback, can inject script that runs when students open their grades.

findings.cweName: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Attributes (mass assignment)
findings.title: Profile update binds the role field
findings.description: updateProfile() binds the request body directly onto the User entity, including the role and enrollment fields. A student can promote their own account to instructor by adding a role field to the request.

findings.cweName: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts
findings.title: No lockout on student and instructor login
findings.description: Failed logins are not counted, so student and instructor passwords can be guessed without limit.

findings.title: Grades readable for any student id
findings.description: The grades API returns grades for the studentId in the path without checking that it matches the logged-in student or an instructor of the course.

findings.title: LTI tool configuration URL fetched without destination checks
findings.description: When an instructor registers an external LTI tool, the server fetches its configuration URL without restricting the destination, which allows requests to internal services.

findings.cweName: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File
findings.title: Password reset links logged at DEBUG
findings.description: The reset flow logs the full reset link, including its token, at DEBUG level, and DEBUG logging is enabled in production.

findings.title: Open redirect after login via redirect parameter
findings.description: After login the handler redirects to the redirect query parameter without checking the host, so crafted login links can send students to a look-alike site.
